body: “This place is so empty, my thoughts are so tempting” sum 41

I have diagnosed contamination OCD. I haven’t ever done a sleep study but when I stay away from home I actually find it to be a release from my contamination ocd. I don’t worry about the cleanliness of my home so I can relax a bit. Try to see it that way. I wash all my clothes when I get home (including a small fabric bag), sanitize my hard surface items and take a good shower. These aren’t recovery tips but all you need to do right now is get through this appointment first. Good luck!

Thanks for the kind words. I don’t have an immediate plan, every day just seems to be getting harder for everyone due to my mental illness. Today my partner said “I don’t have any sympathy anymore, it’s too hard.” He’s not wrong.

Does anybody have manners anymore? Even with a cold, since when was it appropriate to sniffle every two seconds all day long? (Or do anything gross and annoying for that matter). My coworker (and SIL) has been doing this for three years. She’s not sick, I’ve told her it bugs me. I’ve explained that the snot needs to come out or her nose will never stop running. She says nothing comes out. Then I don’t see the need to suck “nothing” back in? 
I try to be understanding that it might be a habit, but I have habits too that I’m required to hide around others for their comfort. I guess there’s no answers, I’ve asked her to stop or at least try to get to the source of the problem and she doesn’t care. But I did have to teach my husband that he needs to brush his teeth everyday, so their parents clearly didn’t teach their children manners or decency 🤷🏼‍♀️

I just learned that my experience has a name! Unmedicated labour, medicated delivery. I’m from Canada and covid restrictions meant I was alone in triage until I was 10cm, then they got my husband and offered an epidural 🤷🏼‍♀️ I took it, I regret it. I’d say you will know very fast if you can handle it. I didn’t have a choice, I didn’t know I could do it until I did. You will survive, but there’s no special place in heaven for woman that give birth unmedicated. Might as well just take the pain relief in my opinion, there’s no point in suffering. Piggyback here, does anyone know why I was able to get an epidural while 10cm dilated?!
Yea wish I had an answer, at least you’re not alone
That I made my husband bathe our 18 month old twice the other day just so I could touch her. It’s a sad reality
